fusions.name: Mobbing Swipe
fusions.desc: Swipes at every enemy within 2 tiles for 3 damage. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you (max +40%).

fusions.name: Pile-On Finish
fusions.desc: Only usable on a target at or below 25% health. Dives onto it for 22 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Scrabbling Mischief
fusions.desc: Whistles up a mischief of rats that fights for 12 seconds, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second.

fusions.name: Not Going Down
fusions.desc: Once every 60 seconds, a blow that would kill you is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
